name: identify-research
description: First step of the pipeline: /wtfMS:identify-research from an empty workspace, producing RESEARCH.md. Seedless -- each rep starts clean. A real end-to-end run also snapshots its output into fixtures/state/after-identify to seed the next step.

measure.prompt:
/wtfMS:identify-research

Run FULLY AUTONOMOUSLY: do NOT call AskUserQuestion, do NOT run any git commands (no init/add/commit). Use reasonable defaults for anything unspecified. Complete the whole skill end-to-end.

Inputs:
- Domain: Structural materials / additive manufacturing (laser powder bed fusion)
- Driving question: Which LPBF process-parameter combinations (laser power, scan
  speed, hatch spacing, layer thickness, volumetric energy density) minimize
  porosity and lack-of-fusion defects in Ti-6Al-4V, and what processing map can
  be extracted from published process-defect datasets?
- Motivation: process-parameter optimization to minimize defects (literature synthesis)
- Resources: literature only (published papers + public datasets); laptop-scale
  statistical analysis; no lab, no HPC
- Career stage: industry researcher; Timeline: flexible; Constraints: none

Write .research/RESEARCH.md via the research-explorer subagent. Stop at RESEARCH IDENTIFIED.
